components.name: Download Button
components.description: The one orange primary per screen, header right. Dark lobby ink, never white.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-download" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 17v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2v-2"/><path d="M7 11l5 5l5 -5"/><path d="M12 4v12"/></svg>Download</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-download { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--orange, #f7931e); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--orange, #f7931e); color: var(--on-orange, #1c1103); font: 700 0.75rem/1 Exo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-download:hover { background: var(--orange-hover, #fdb74b); border-color: var(--orange-hover, #fdb74b); } .ds-btn-download:active { background: var(--orange-press, #d97b0d); border-color: var(--orange-press, #d97b0d); } .ds-btn-download:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default action. Hover is a raised fill, never orange.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #042a52cc); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #ffffff); font: 500 0.875rem/1 Roboto, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--raised, #141d35); border-color: var(--subtle, #64748b); } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--sunken, #0a0e1a); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Franchise Chip
components.description: Header control: sticker thumbnail, mono prefix code, Exo name. Opens the franchise wall.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 10px 0 4px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #042a52cc); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sunken, #0a0e1a); color: var(--text, #ffffff); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--subtle, #64748b); background: var(--raised, #141d35); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-art { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--orange, #f7931e); } .ds-chip-code { padding-right: 10px; border-right: 1px solid var(--hairline, #1e293b); font: 700 0.75rem/1 "Martian Mono", Monaco, monospace; } .ds-chip-name { font: 700 0.9375rem/1.2 Exo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-chip svg { color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); }

components.name: Tool Tabs
components.description: SIGN / TEXT / BACKGROUND in a sunken track; the selected tab is navy.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(4, 42, 82, 0.8)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sunken, #0a0e1a); } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); font: 700 0.75rem/1 Exo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #ffffff); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--navy, #07407b); color: var(--on-navy, #ffffff); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Layer Chip
components.description: Pill per signature or text layer; pressed (selected) is navy.
components.css: .ds-layer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #042a52cc); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #f1f5f9); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 Roboto, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-layer:hover { border-color: var(--subtle, #64748b); background: var(--raised, #141d35); } .ds-layer[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--navy, #07407b); background: var(--navy, #07407b); color: var(--on-navy, #ffffff); } .ds-layer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Range Slider
components.description: Layer scale, rotation and opacity: navy fill to the value, white thumb with a navy ring, mono readout.
components.css: .ds-range { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 148px; } .ds-range-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); font: 700 0.75rem/1 Exo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-range-label output { color: var(--text-2, #f1f5f9); font: 500 0.6875rem/1 "Martian Mono", Monaco, monospace; text-transform: none; } .ds-range input { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 20px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-range input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--navy-hover, #0a5299) var(--fill), var(--track, #1e293b) var(--fill)); } .ds-range input::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: -6px; border: 2px solid var(--navy-hover, #0a5299); border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; } .ds-range input::-moz-range-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--navy-hover, #0a5299) var(--fill), var(--track, #1e293b) var(--fill)); } .ds-range input::-moz-range-thumb { width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--navy-hover, #0a5299); border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; } .ds-range input:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-range input:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kit Tile
components.description: Aspect-true live thumbnail with kerned label and mono size. Current is ringed orange; a missing asset reads "Not made for X yet".
components.css: .ds-kit { display: flex; gap: 8px; width: 340px; } .ds-kit-tile { flex: var(--ar) 1 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-kit-thumb { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: var(--ar); border-radius: 3px; background-color: var(--check-a, #0c1222); background-image: conic-gradient(var(--check-b, #111a2e) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--check-b, #111a2e) 0 75%, transparent 0); background-size: 10px 10px; outline: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(4, 42, 82, 0.8)); transition: outline-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-kit-tile:hover .ds-kit-thumb { outline-color: var(--subtle, #64748b); } .ds-kit-tile:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-kit-tile:focus-visible .ds-kit-thumb { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdb74b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kit-tile[data-current] .ds-kit-thumb { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #f7931e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kit-label { color: var(--text-2, #f1f5f9); font: 700 0.6875rem/1.25 Exo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-kit-size { color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); font: 500 0.625rem/1 "Martian Mono", Monaco, monospace; } .ds-kit-tile[data-state="unavailable"] { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-kit-tile[data-state="unavailable"] .ds-kit-thumb { background: var(--sunken, #0a0e1a); outline-style: dashed; outline-color: var(--border-strong, #1d3a5f); } .ds-kit-tile[data-state="unavailable"] .ds-kit-label { color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); } .ds-kit-state { padding: 6px; color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.3 Roboto, sans-serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: Franchise Wall Item
components.description: One team in the packed wall grid; the chosen franchise is ringed orange.
components.css: .ds-wall-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 104px; padding: 10px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(4, 42, 82, 0.8)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sunken, #0a0e1a); color: var(--text, #ffffff); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-wall-item:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #1d3a5f); background: var(--raised, #141d35); } .ds-wall-item[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--orange, #f7931e); outline: 1px solid var(--orange, #f7931e); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-wall-item:focus-visible, .ds-wall-item[aria-current="true"]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #ffffff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-wall-art { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--orange, #f7931e); } .ds-wall-code { font: 700 0.8125rem/1 "Martian Mono", Monaco, monospace; } .ds-wall-name { color: var(--muted, #94a3b8); font: 400 0.75rem/1.25 Roboto, sans-serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: Selection Box
components.description: The selected layer on the stage: orange outline over a dark inner edge, white corner handles, round rotate handle on a stem.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; width: 240px; height: 180px; background-color: var(--check-a, #0c1222); background-image: conic-gradient(var(--check-b, #111a2e) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--check-b, #111a2e) 0 75%, transparent 0); background-size: 16px 16px; outline: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(4, 42, 82, 0.8)); } .ds-box { position: absolute; inset: 50px 50px 40px; border: 1px solid var(--box-edge, rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.55)); outline: 1.5px solid var(--orange, #f7931e); } .ds-h { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--orange, #f7931e); border-radius: 2px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-h.tl { top: -7px; left: -7px; } .ds-h.tr { top: -7px; right: -7px; } .ds-h.bl { bottom: -7px; left: -7px; } .ds-h.br { bottom: -7px; right: -7px; } .ds-h.rot { top: -30px; left: 50%; border-radius: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-h.rot::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; width: 1.5px; height: 15px; margin-top: 2px; background: var(--orange, #f7931e); transform: translateX(-50%); }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Signing Table"**

**Parent system: [CSC-Web DESIGN.md](https://github.com/csconfederation/CSC-Web/blob/main/DESIGN.md), the Match-Night Lobby.** It is binding. Its palette, type stack, Kerned-Label, Two-Color, Floodlight and No-Shadow rules apply here unchanged. This file records only the tokens this surface ships, its own components, and where it deliberately departs from the parent.

The surface is a tool, not a page. The franchise art is the only saturated field; the chrome is the slate stack in 1px borders, so the sticker reads first. One orange primary (Download) per screen, and orange marks what is currently selected.
keyCharacteristics: Every color is a CSS custom property in `css/styles.css`; `[data-theme="light"]` (set from CSC-Web's postMessage) swaps in the light set from CSC-Web's lobby and combine-queue values.
Flat: tonal layers and 1px borders, zero `box-shadow`.
Exo kerned labels, Roboto body, Martian Mono for sizes and prefix codes.
Desktop holds stage, tray and kit in one viewport; phones stack them.
One authored motion: the signature stamping onto the kit.

rules.name: The Art-Is-The-Field Rule
rules.body: Only the franchise art is saturated. Chrome never takes a tier, performance or extra brand color.

rules.name: The Orange-Means-Current Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only on Download (and its hover and press), the current-selection rings (kit tile on stage, chosen franchise, selected layer's box), focus (`focus` rings, the input border, the caret), text selection, the accent bar and warning toasts. No control but Download turns orange on hover.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Measures Rule
rules.body: Pixel sizes, prefix codes and numeric readouts are Martian Mono; nothing else is.

dos: Do take every color from the custom properties in `css/styles.css` and add a `[data-theme="light"]` value for any new one.
Do keep orange to Download, the current selection, focus and the accent bar.
Do show a missing asset as an unavailable tile ("Not made for X yet"), never as an error.
Do keep thumbnails aspect-true and live; keep the stage and export at exact scale.
Do put sizes, codes and readouts in Martian Mono, and labels in the Exo kerned label.
Do keep 44px touch targets under `pointer: coarse` and cut all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't put white text on Floodlight Orange.
Don't add `box-shadow`; use a tonal step or a stronger border.
Don't let a tool switch or the signing pad resize the stage.
Don't add a second orange button, or an orange hover on anything but Download.
Don't add motion beyond the 180ms state transitions, the 200ms wall rise and toast, the loading shimmer, the busy-icon spin and the landing stamp.
